# Version 4.151.0 (Unreleased)
> **Graphite backend and memory fixes**

## Highlights

This unreleased 4.151.0 work adds the Graphite GPU backend, async pixel reads, and two native memory-leak fixes. Graphite bindings bring hardware-accelerated Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn support under a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package. Two native use-after-free leaks are closed, and async RequestReadPixels lands on SKImage and SKSurface.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn** — New bindings expose the Skia Graphite next-generation GPU backend for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, shipped as a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package with cross-platform test coverage on Android and Linux. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968), [#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **Backend-neutral async RequestReadPixels on SKImage and SKSurface** — A new async RequestReadPixels API lets callers read back rendered pixels from any GPU backend without blocking the render thread. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **FreeType font support on Nano Server** — Uses FreeType for font rendering on Windows Nano Server, which has no GDI font stack, enabling text rendering in containerized server workloads. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native use-after-free in SKRegion.SpanIterator fixed** — The underlying SKRegion was being collected while the iterator still held a native pointer; the region is now kept alive for the iterator's lifetime. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355))
- **Pixel-buffer leak in SKImage.Create raster failure path closed** — When SKImage.Create failed after allocating a CoTaskMem pixel buffer, the buffer was leaked; it is now freed on the failure path. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))
- **Native use-after-free in SKPixmap.ExtractSubset and With* fixed** — The parent pixel source was not kept alive across ExtractSubset and the With* family of SKPixmap methods, causing intermittent native crashes. ([#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
